translations.attribution: Nachman of Breslov; English translation by Simcha H. Nanach and Wikisource contributors; see the linked revision history. Selected passages indexed using a Sefaria export.
translations.changes: Amudi selected source-checked numbered passages, removed page markup, grouped them by topic and part in source-schema order, and left unmatched numbered positions empty. Documented heading variants, part boundaries and explicit numbering are used; changed Wikisource wording was individually compared to the older indexed edition. Literal ampersands and angle brackets were escaped for faithful reader display. No new translation or OCR was produced. Three further passages use individually reviewed current and historical source revisions; the historical source and contributors are linked in the manifest. Twenty-five topic headings were labeled Part II after comparing each retained passage to the source part boundary.
translations.coverageStatus: Partial English edition: 2,679 numbered passages from 158 topic/part sections checked against pinned Wikisource revisions. Unmatched passages, introductions and other source material are omitted. The Hebrew main work is not included or paired here; this is not a complete work.
